node.title: Update shortcut link to SSCCE
node.author: 1nickt
node.doctext:
The current link from [SSCCE] points to [id://1177743|node # 1177743], which is a page containing only one thing: a link to [id://1177642|node # 1177642] -- the page that actually describes what an SSCCE is. The handy syntax link is great, but could it be updated to point directly to the page? I don't really see the point of the intermediary page, and I fear that some newbs who click to it won't manage to click through to the real doc. Studies about page depth and retention show ... , etc. and the link doesn't exactly stand out.

Can we do away with the intermediary page and update the link?


The way forward always starts with a minimal test.
